verses.original: אָ֣ז מֹשֶׁה֩ וּבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ יָשִֽׁיר־ הַזֹּאת֙ הַשִּׁירָ֤ה לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz mō·šeh ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- yā·šîr- haz·zōṯ haš·šî·rāh Yah·weh way·yō·mə·rū lê·mōr ’ā·šî·rāh Yah·weh kî- ḡā·’ōh gā·’āh sūs wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw rā·māh ḇay·yām
verses.literal: Then Moses and the Israelites . . . - sang this song to the LORD - - I will sing to the LORD for He is highly exalted . . . The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea

verses.original: יָ֔הּ עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ וַֽיְהִי־ לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִי֙ וְאַנְוֵ֔הוּ אָבִ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֥י וַאֲרֹמְמֶֽנְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yāh ‘āz·zî wə·zim·rāṯ way·hî- lî lî·šū·‘āh zeh ’ê·lî wə·’an·wê·hū ’ā·ḇî ’ĕ·lō·hê wa·’ă·rō·mə·men·hū
verses.literal: The LORD is my strength and my song and He has become my salvation He [is] my God and I will praise Him my father’s God and I will exalt Him

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’îš mil·ḥā·māh Yah·weh šə·mōw
verses.literal: The LORD is a warrior . . . the LORD is His name

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֛ה מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת וְחֵיל֖וֹ יָרָ֣ה בַיָּ֑ם וּמִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖יו טֻבְּע֥וּ סֽוּף׃ בְיַם־
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh mar·kə·ḇōṯ wə·ḥê·lōw yā·rāh ḇay·yām ū·miḇ·ḥar šā·li·šāw ṭub·bə·‘ū sūp̄ ḇə·yam-
verses.literal: Pharaoh’s chariots and army He has cast into the sea the finest of his officers are drowned in the Red Sea

verses.original: תְּהֹמֹ֖ת יְכַסְיֻ֑מוּ יָרְד֥וּ בִמְצוֹלֹ֖ת כְּמוֹ־ אָֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hō·mōṯ yə·ḵas·yu·mū yā·rə·ḏū ḇim·ṣō·w·lōṯ kə·mōw- ’ā·ḇen
verses.literal: The depths have covered them they sank [there] like a stone

verses.original: יְמִֽינְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּכֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yə·mî·nə·ḵā Yah·weh ne’·dā·rî bak·kō·aḥ yə·mî·nə·ḵā Yah·weh tir·‘aṣ ’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: Your right hand O LORD is majestic in power Your right hand O LORD has shattered the enemy

verses.original: תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְךָ֖ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖מוֹ כַּקַּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ta·hă·rōs qā·me·ḵā ū·ḇə·rōḇ gə·’ō·wn·ḵā tə·šal·laḥ ḥă·rō·nə·ḵā yō·ḵə·lê·mōw kaq·qaš
verses.literal: You overthrew Your adversaries by Your great majesty You unleashed Your burning wrath it consumed them like stubble

verses.original: וּבְר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ מַ֔יִם נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ כְמוֹ־ נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים נִצְּב֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת קָֽפְא֥וּ בְּלֶב־ יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·rū·aḥ ’ap·pe·ḵā ma·yim ne·‘er·mū ḵə·mōw- nêḏ nō·zə·lîm niṣ·ṣə·ḇū ṯə·hō·mōṯ qā·p̄ə·’ū bə·leḇ- yām
verses.literal: At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up like a wall the currents stood firm the depths congealed in the heart of the sea

verses.original: אוֹיֵ֛ב אָמַ֥ר אֶרְדֹּ֥ף אַשִּׂ֖יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֑ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣מוֹ נַפְשִׁ֔י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔י יָדִֽי׃ תּוֹרִישֵׁ֖מוֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·yêḇ ’ā·mar ’er·dōp̄ ’aś·śîḡ ’ă·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl tim·lā·’ê·mōw nap̄·šî ’ā·rîq ḥar·bî yā·ḏî tō·w·rî·šê·mōw
verses.literal: The enemy declared I will pursue I will overtake I will divide the spoils I will gorge myself on them I will draw my sword my hand will destroy them

verses.original: נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ֖ יָ֑ם כִּסָּ֣מוֹ צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽעוֹפֶ֔רֶת אַדִּירִֽים׃ בְּמַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: nā·šap̄·tā ḇə·rū·ḥă·ḵā yām kis·sā·mōw ṣā·lă·lū ka·‘ō·w·p̄e·reṯ ’ad·dî·rîm bə·ma·yim
verses.literal: But You blew with Your breath and the sea covered them They sank like lead in the mighty waters

verses.original: מִֽי־ בָּֽאֵלִם֙ כָמֹ֤כָה יְהוָ֔ה מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
verses.transliteration: mî- bā·’ê·lim ḵā·mō·ḵāh Yah·weh mî kā·mō·ḵāh ne’·dār baq·qō·ḏeš nō·w·rā ṯə·hil·lōṯ ‘ō·śêh p̄e·le
verses.literal: Who among the gods is like You O LORD Who is like You majestic in holiness revered with praises performing wonders

verses.original: נָטִ֙יתָ֙ יְמִ֣ינְךָ֔ אָֽרֶץ׃ תִּבְלָעֵ֖מוֹ
verses.transliteration: nā·ṭî·ṯā yə·mî·nə·ḵā ’ā·reṣ tiḇ·lā·‘ê·mōw
verses.literal: You stretched out Your right hand and the earth swallowed them up

verses.original: בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ נָחִ֥יתָ עַם־ ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֖ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ אֶל־ קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃ נְוֵ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ḇə·ḥas·də·ḵā nā·ḥî·ṯā ‘am- zū gā·’ā·lə·tā ḇə·‘āz·zə·ḵā nê·hal·tā ’el- qāḏ·še·ḵā nə·wêh
verses.literal: With loving devotion You will lead the people . . . You have redeemed with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling

verses.original: עַמִּ֖ים שָֽׁמְע֥וּ יִרְגָּז֑וּן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mîm šā·mə·‘ū yir·gā·zūn ḥîl ’ā·ḥaz yō·šə·ḇê pə·lā·šeṯ
verses.literal: The nations will hear [and] tremble anguish will grip the dwellers of Philistia

verses.original: אָ֤ז אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם נִבְהֲלוּ֙ רָ֑עַד יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖מוֹ אֵילֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃ נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל
verses.transliteration: ’āz ’al·lū·p̄ê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm niḇ·hă·lū rā·‘aḏ yō·ḥă·zê·mōw ’ê·lê mō·w·’āḇ yō·šə·ḇê ḵə·nā·‘an nā·mō·ḡū kōl
verses.literal: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed trembling will seize the leaders of Moab those who dwell in Canaan will melt away . . .

verses.original: אֵימָ֙תָה֙ וָפַ֔חַד תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם בִּגְדֹ֥ל זְרוֹעֲךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּאָ֑בֶן עַד־ עַמְּךָ֙ יַעֲבֹ֤ר יְהוָ֔ה עַֽד־ עַם־ ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ׃ יַעֲבֹ֖ר
verses.transliteration: ’ê·mā·ṯāh wā·p̄a·ḥaḏ tip·pōl ‘ă·lê·hem biḡ·ḏōl zə·rō·w·‘ă·ḵā yid·də·mū kā·’ā·ḇen ‘aḏ- ‘am·mə·ḵā ya·‘ă·ḇōr Yah·weh ‘aḏ- ‘am- zū qā·nî·ṯā ya·‘ă·ḇōr
verses.literal: and terror and dread will fall on them By the power of Your arm they will be as still as a stone until Your people pass by O LORD until the people - You have bought pass by

verses.original: תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֙מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔ מָכ֧וֹן יְהוָ֑ה פָּעַ֖לְתָּ לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ מִקְּדָ֕שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י יָדֶֽיךָ׃ כּוֹנְנ֥וּ
verses.transliteration: tə·ḇi·’ê·mōw wə·ṯiṭ·ṭā·‘ê·mōw bə·har na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā mā·ḵō·wn Yah·weh pā·‘al·tā lə·šiḇ·tə·ḵā miq·qə·ḏāš ’ă·ḏō·nāy yā·ḏe·ḵā kō·wn·nū
verses.literal: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance the place O LORD You have prepared for Your dwelling the sanctuary O Lord Your hands have established

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה׀ יִמְלֹ֖ךְ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yim·lōḵ lə·‘ō·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: The LORD will reign forever and ever

verses.original: כִּ֣י פַּרְעֹ֜ה ס֨וּס בְּרִכְבּ֤וֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו֙ בָא֩ בַּיָּ֔ם יְהוָ֛ה מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם וַיָּ֧שֶׁב עֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת־ וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃פ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kî par·‘ōh sūs bə·riḵ·bōw ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šāw ḇā bay·yām Yah·weh mê hay·yām way·yā·šeḇ ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·lə·ḵū bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām ḇay·yab·bā·šāh
verses.literal: For when Pharaoh’s horses chariots and horsemen went into the sea the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them - But the Israelites . . . walked through the sea on dry ground

verses.original: מִרְיָ֨ם הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־ אֲח֧וֹת וַתִּקַּח֩ הַתֹּ֖ף בְּיָדָ֑הּ כָֽל־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּצֶ֤אןָ בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבִמְחֹלֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: mir·yām han·nə·ḇî·’āh ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·wṯ wat·tiq·qaḥ hat·tōp̄ bə·yā·ḏāh ḵāl han·nā·šîm ’a·ḥă·re·hā wat·tê·ṣe·nā bə·ṯup·pîm ū·ḇim·ḥō·lōṯ
verses.literal: Then Miriam the prophetess Aaron’s - sister took a tambourine in her hand and all the women . . . followed her with tambourines and dancing

verses.original: מִרְיָ֑ם וַתַּ֥עַן לָהֶ֖ם שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: mir·yām wat·ta·‘an lā·hem šî·rū Yah·weh kî- ḡā·’ōh gā·’āh sūs wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw rā·māh ḇay·yām
verses.literal: And Miriam sang back to them Sing to the LORD for He is highly exalted . . . the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־ וַיַּסַּ֨ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ס֔וּף מִיַּם־ וַיֵּצְא֖וּ אֶל־ מִדְבַּר־ שׁ֑וּר שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת־ יָמִ֛ים וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְלֹא־ מָ֥צְאוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yas·sa‘ yiś·rā·’êl sūp̄ mî·yam- way·yê·ṣə·’ū ’el- miḏ·bar- šūr šə·lō·šeṯ- yā·mîm way·yê·lə·ḵū bam·miḏ·bār wə·lō- mā·ṣə·’ū mā·yim
verses.literal: Then Moses - led Israel from the Red Sea and they went out into the Desert of Shur For three days they walked in the desert without finding water

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ מָרָ֔תָה יָֽכְל֗וּ וְלֹ֣א לִשְׁתֹּ֥ת מַ֙יִם֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה כִּ֥י הֵ֑ם מָרִ֖ים עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־ שְׁמָ֖הּ מָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū mā·rā·ṯāh yā·ḵə·lū wə·lō liš·tōṯ ma·yim mim·mā·rāh kî hêm mā·rîm ‘al- kên qā·rā- šə·māh mā·rāh
verses.literal: And when they came to Marah they could not drink the water [there] because it was bitter That is why . . . it was named . . . Marah

verses.original: הָעָ֛ם וַיִּלֹּ֧נוּ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר מַה־ נִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām way·yil·lō·nū ‘al- mō·šeh lê·mōr mah- niš·teh
verses.literal: So the people grumbled against Moses saying What are we to drink

verses.original: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה יְהוָה֙ וַיּוֹרֵ֤הוּ עֵ֔ץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶל־ הַמַּ֔יִם הַמָּ֑יִם וַֽיִּמְתְּק֖וּ שָׁ֣ם שָׂ֥ם ל֛וֹ חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וְשָׁ֥ם נִסָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘aq ’el- Yah·weh Yah·weh way·yō·w·rê·hū ‘êṣ way·yaš·lêḵ ’el- ham·ma·yim ham·mā·yim way·yim·tə·qū šām śām lōw ḥōq ū·miš·pāṭ wə·šām nis·sā·hū
verses.literal: And [Moses] cried out to the LORD and the LORD showed him a log And when he cast it into the waters [they] were sweetened There [the LORD] made for them a statute and an ordinance and there He tested them

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִם־ שָׁמ֨וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֜ע לְק֣וֹל׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְהַיָּשָׁ֤ר בְּעֵינָיו֙ וְהַֽאֲזַנְתָּ֙ לְמִצְוֺתָ֔יו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֖ כָּל־ חֻקָּ֑יו לֹא־ שַׂ֤מְתִּי עָלֶ֔יךָ כָּֽל־ הַמַּֽחֲלָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ אָשִׂ֣ים בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֹפְאֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·ma‘ lə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ta·‘ă·śeh wə·hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nāw wə·ha·’ă·zan·tā lə·miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·šā·mar·tā kāl- ḥuq·qāw lō- śam·tî ‘ā·le·ḵā kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·lāh ’ă·šer- ’ā·śîm ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh rō·p̄ə·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: saying If you will listen carefully . . . to the voice of the LORD your God and do what is right in His eyes and pay attention to His commands and keep all His statutes [then] I will not bring on you any of the diseases - I inflicted on the Egyptians For I am the LORD who heals you

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵילִ֔מָה וְשָׁ֗ם שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֖יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים תְּמָרִ֑ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־ שָׁ֖ם עַל־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·li·māh wə·šām šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ‘ê·nōṯ ma·yim wə·šiḇ·‘îm tə·mā·rîm way·ya·ḥă·nū- šām ‘al- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then they came to Elim where there were twelve . . . springs of water and seventy palm trees and they camped there by the waters
